figures.Fig31.6: Fractional distillation of crude oil into useful hydrocarbons. Original figure archived as c12-chem-ch31-fig-distillation (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: Figure 31.6 labels kerosene 'C10H14', which is not an alkane formula; kerosene is roughly C10-C16. It prints lubricating oils as C15-C20, overlapping diesel (C14-C19); other references give about C20-C50. Carried as printed with a warning; flagged for review.

The gasoline range is printed as '<40 C - 200 C' and is carried as printed. The Quick Check questions are printed without answers; the lesson's answers were derived for it and need the second-person review.
